description: Blazor host for the canvas-based document editing engine. Renders the mount root with stacked canvas layers (background, content, objects, selection, annotations, diagnostics), an accessibility mirror, live region, and hidden input, and bootstraps and drives the JavaScript canvas editor through a broad JS interop surface covering document replace, command execution, clipboard, collaboration, comments, and export.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document accepted by the canvas engine host.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible label for the canvas document surface.

parameters.name: Author
parameters.description: Current document author used by tracked canvas changes.

parameters.name: ContentControlRenderMode
parameters.description: Canvas content-control rendering mode. Use form for plain fill mode or design for structured-tag chrome.

parameters.name: ImageProvider
parameters.description: Optional image provider used by canvas upload and clipboard image flows.

parameters.name: ImageUrlResolver
parameters.description: Optional resolver for provider-managed document image assets.

parameters.name: ImageValidation
parameters.description: Validation policy for provider-backed canvas image uploads.

parameters.name: InputAriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible label for the hidden keyboard and IME bridge.

parameters.name: OnAnnotationSelected
parameters.description: Raised when a canvas comment or revision marker is selected.

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the canvas engine reports a model change. This is a plain delegate rather than an EventCallback{T} ON PURPOSE: it fires on every keystroke, and an EventCallback would auto-invoke StateHasChanged on the (very large) parent editor after every keystroke, re-rendering the whole toolbar/ribbon/chrome and freezing typing. The parent owns its own (debounced) re-render.

parameters.name: OnCommandPaletteRequested
parameters.description: Raised when a canvas keyboard shortcut requests the command palette.

parameters.name: OnContextMenu
parameters.description: Raised when the canvas engine requests a context menu at the pointer location.

parameters.name: OnMiniToolbarChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the canvas selection changes (mini toolbar show/hide). A plain delegate, NOT an EventCallback, for the same reason as OnChanged: the selection changes on every keystroke (the caret moves), and an EventCallback would auto-render the whole parent editor each time. The parent re-renders itself only when the selection-driven state actually changes.

parameters.name: OnReady
parameters.description: Raised when the JavaScript canvas host has mounted and reported readiness.

parameters.name: OnRibbonFocusRequested
parameters.description: Raised when a canvas keyboard shortcut requests focus to move to the ribbon.

parameters.name: OnUiStateChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the small primitives-only UI snapshot (formatting pressed-state, dirty, undo/redo availability, page count) the engine pushes alongside a deliberate selection change (B2). Lets the parent update the toolbar immediately without a follow-up interop pull. A plain delegate for the same reason as OnMiniToolbarChanged.

parameters.name: OnVersionsPanelRequested
parameters.description: Raised when a canvas keyboard shortcut requests the versions side panel.

parameters.name: Permissions
parameters.description: Host-controlled permissions used to expose the canvas shell state.

parameters.name: ProofingOptions
parameters.description: Host-supplied proofing options used by the canvas diagnostics overlay.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether editing should be disabled for the canvas host.

parameters.name: ReviewDisplayMode
parameters.description: Current canvas review display mode for tracked revisions.

parameters.name: SigningRoles
parameters.description: Signer roles used to colour inline signing fields by submitter (plan S2).

parameters.name: TrackChangesEnabled
parameters.description: Whether canvas tracked changes are enabled.
